pull_request.body:
## Summary

This PR standardizes error handling across the affected module by replacing inconsistent patterns with the project's defined custom `Result` type.

### Changes

* Replaced inconsistent `unwrap` and `expect` usage where appropriate.
* Standardized error propagation using the project's custom `Result` type.
* Added any required variants to the shared `Error` enum.
* Improved consistency and maintainability of error handling.

### Validation

* Ran the full test suite.
* Verified all existing functionality remains unchanged.
* Confirmed the project builds successfully and passes all checks.

Closes #214
## Summary

This PR improves the Windows setup documentation by providing platform-specific instructions for contributors using PowerShell.

### Changes

* Added PowerShell equivalents for setup commands.
* Documented Windows PATH configuration where applicable.
* Clarified environment setup steps for Windows users.
* Reviewed documentation for platform-specific assumptions.

### Validation

* Reviewed documentation for accuracy and completeness.
* Verified command examples are consistent with the existing setup process.
* Ensured documentation changes do not impact the build.

Closes #215
## Summary

This PR improves code readability by replacing ambiguous variable names with descriptive, domain-specific names.

### Changes

* Renamed single-letter and unclear variable names.
* Improved naming consistency throughout the module.
* Preserved existing functionality without changing behavior.
* Reviewed the file for similar naming improvements.

### Validation

* Ran the full test suite.
* Verified no behavioral changes were introduced.
* Confirmed the project builds successfully and passes all checks.

Closes #218
## Summary

This PR improves the performance of the internal state tracking implementation by replacing linear lookups with hash-based data structures.

### Changes

* Replaced linear state tracking structures with hash-based collections where appropriate.
* Reduced lookup complexity for larger inputs.
* Preserved existing behavior while improving scalability.
* Added benchmark comparisons to measure the performance improvement.

### Validation

* Benchmarked performance before and after the optimization.
* Ran the full test suite.
* Verified the project builds successfully and passes all checks.

Closes #219
